# Contract name

Status: Draft | Accepted. Delivery status is tracked in the issue, not here.

## 1. Scope

Which scopes and callers this contract covers, and what it does not cover.

## 2. Names and data

The service, event, method or data names, their shapes and their owners. One name has one
meaning across languages.

## 3. Ordering and errors

Ordering, admission, cancellation and error behavior that callers can observe. Do not describe
an implementation that callers cannot rely on.

## 4. Compatibility

What may change, what is versioned and what callers may assume across reloads, restarts and
forks.

## 5. Binding appendix

Exact Rust or TypeScript spelling. Semantics stay above this section.
